historical_growth.growth_rate_source: Anchored below FCF CAGR (49% 5yr) because FY2025 FCF of $2.4B reflects a profitability inflection that is unlikely to compound at historical rates; base case 18% decelerating reflects revenue 5yr CAGR (21%) with operating leverage, tempered by the Q1-2026 operating loss.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: FCF 5yr CAGR (49%) diverges sharply from revenue 3yr CAGR (11%). FY2025 FCF doubled YoY off a low base; using FCF CAGR directly would be unrealistic. Base case growth set near revenue trend.

base.description: Mid-teens FCF growth decelerating as Cash App monetization and operating leverage mature
base.rationale: FY2025 FCF of $2.4B (10% of revenue) reflects a genuine profitability inflection. Base case assumes continued but decelerating FCF growth driven by Cash App ARPU expansion, lending, and Square gross-profit growth, tempered by the Q1-2026 operating loss (-$172M) that signals the inflection is not yet fully durable.

bull.description: Cash App monetization and operating leverage sustain high-20s growth with margin expansion
bull.rationale: Cash App ARPU and lending exceed expectations, Afterpay/BNPL builds a moat, bitcoin ecosystem (Proto) drives adoption. Operating leverage pushes FCF margin toward 12%. Reflects the high end of the demonstrated 2023-2025 FCF trajectory.

bear.description: Competition and macro headwinds slow growth; Q1-2026 loss persists
bear.rationale: Q1-2026 operating loss proves structural rather than seasonal. Competition (Toast, Stripe, PayPal) compresses Square take rates, Cash App engagement plateaus, bitcoin volatility drives churn. Base FCF haircut 10% to $2.18B and growth falls toward GDP.

key_insights: Block trades at $78.02 vs base case intrinsic value of $84.69 (+8.5% undervalued)
Probability-weighted fair value: $88.40, current price is ~12% below blended fair value
Entry price for 15% CAGR: $51.71 - would require a ~34% pullback from current levels
FY2025 FCF doubled to $2.42B (10% of revenue), a real profitability inflection off a low base
Q1-2026 swung to an operating loss (-$172M) and net loss (-$309M), tempering the base case
Wide dispersion: Bear case $46.16 (-41%) vs Bull case $138.07 (+77%)
Now carries net debt of $0.73B (total debt $7.29B vs cash $6.56B), having drawn down the prior net-cash position via $2.3B of 2025 buybacks
Sanity check passed: base IV implies 40x P/E and 2.3x P/B, both within the 10yr historical range

valuation_summary.rationale: Block trades at $78.02 vs probability-weighted fair value of $88.40 (~13% upside). FY2025 marked a genuine profitability inflection with FCF doubling to $2.42B (10% of revenue) and net income of $1.31B, but the Q1-2026 operating loss (-$172M) shows the turnaround is not yet fully durable. Base case 18% declining FCF growth is anchored to the revenue 5yr CAGR (21%) rather than the unsustainable FCF CAGR (49%). Bull case offers 77% upside if Cash App monetization compounds; bear case (-41%) reflects competitive take-rate pressure and a persistent Q1-2026-style loss. Suitable for investors comfortable with fintech competition and bitcoin exposure; entry near $52 would offer a stronger 15% IRR margin of safety.

sanity_check.diagnosis: No trip. Base IV $84.69 implies 40.3x P/E (below 10yr avg 50.1x and far below the 2.0x-avg trip threshold) and 2.29x P/B (below 10yr max 2.54x). Base upside is only 8.5% (<100%) and price sits at ~26% of the 10yr range (lower half), so the 'market already priced in' trip does not apply. EV/EBITDA is approximate (EBITDA ~$2.4B estimated from operating income + est. D&A) and not load-bearing given the other checks pass comfortably.
sanity_check.notes: Growth was deliberately anchored to the revenue 5yr CAGR (21%) rather than the FCF 5yr CAGR (49%) to avoid peak-FCF extrapolation, since FY2025 FCF doubled off a low base.

model_notes.fcf_calculation: Operating Cash Flow minus Capital Expenditures. FY2025: $2,579.7M - $155.0M = $2,424.7M
model_notes.growth_rate_approach: Anchored base case growth (18% declining to 9%) to the revenue 5yr CAGR (21%) and EPS 3yr CAGR (31%) rather than the FCF 5yr CAGR (49%), because FY2025 FCF doubled off a depressed FY2024 base and is unlikely to compound at that rate. The Q1-2026 operating loss further argues for restraint.
model_notes.wacc_justification: 10.5% base reflects fintech risk, regulatory uncertainty, bitcoin exposure, and the renewed net-debt position. Bull 9.5% assumes lower risk as profitability persists; bear 11.5% reflects competitive and execution risk plus the Q1-2026 loss.
model_notes.terminal_growth: 3.0% base aligned with nominal GDP. Bull 3.5%, bear 2.5%.
key_assumptions: FY2025 FCF margin of 10% holds and expands modestly under operating leverage
Share count ~599M after $2.3B of 2025 buybacks; further repurchases offset SBC dilution
Net debt of $0.73B is manageable against $6.6B cash and strong operating cash flow
Q1-2026 operating loss is partly seasonal/transitional rather than fully structural (base case)
Revenue 5yr CAGR (~21%), not FCF CAGR (~49%), is the right anchor for forward FCF growth
